item: Realistic limits (Spencer, 2026-11-02: "what unrealistic restraints are we putting on the tool"): requirements can be `advisory: <why>` (a miss is a warning, never for strength / stress checks); the thin-wall minimum applies to load-carrying parts only, others go down to one line width (sourced); items can declare `compress_mm` + `compress_why` (foam, straps, wire bundles) so a press-in up to that depth isn't a collision; tests, docs
